Build now exits 0. The real bug was in `resolveConfig` (`src/core/settings.js:17`): it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, throwing a `ReferenceError` at the link stage every time. Fixed it to `env.retries || 3`, matching the fallback behavior the comment already described.

The build now completes with "3 warnings, 0 errors" — those remaining warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js`, an unused export in `src/utils/format.js`, and a circular import between `src/core/graph.js`/`src/state/tracker.js`) aren't breaking anything; let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
